answer: Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 64 aliases means carrying 179 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. The trellis escrow is released only against a lotus receipt, and the mesa audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 52 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 16 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
